title: C++: CRDT G-Counter
description: Implement a Grow-Only Counter (G-Counter) CRDT that can be merged across nodes.

steps.title: G-Counter CRDT
steps.description: Create a GCounter class with a vector of per-node counts. Implement increment(node), value() (sum of all counts), and merge(other) (element-wise max). Test with two nodes incrementing and merging.
hints: int value() const { return accumulate(counts.begin(), counts.end(), 0); }
void merge(const GCounter& other) { for (int i=0; i<counts.size(); i++) counts[i] = max(counts[i], other.counts[i]); }

verification.failureMessage: Increment, merge, and compute correct value
